simple.meaning: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize , to rob , to inherit ; also to expel , to impoverish , to ruin
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָרַשׁ (H3423) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 232 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָרַשׁ (yârash) means to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize , to rob , to inherit ; also to expel , to impoverish , to ruin First listed occurrence: 1Chr 28 8.

definitions.short: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize , to rob , to inherit ; also to expel , to impoverish , to ruin
